# Clustering

## Aims {.unnumbered}

- to introduce cluster analysis with focus on partitioning and hierarchical methods

## Learning outcomes {.unnumbered}

- to be able to explain what clustering is
- to be able to run k-means, PAM and HCL cluster analysis
- to be able to evaluate cluster solutions
